title: Construction of this chapter.
bodyText: The powers conferred by this chapter shall be supplemental to the powers conferred by any other law. Nothing contained in this chapter shall prohibit a county from providing for a pollution control project of the nature described in this part as a public undertaking, improvement, or system under chapter 47 or 49.
bodyHtml: §48E-19  Construction of this chapter.  The powers conferred by this chapter shall be supplemental to the powers conferred by any other law.  Nothing contained in this chapter shall prohibit a county from providing for a pollution control project of the nature described in this part as a public undertaking, improvement, or system under chapter 47 or 49. [L 1983, c 237, pt of §2]
